methods.name: as_bytes
methods.summary: Returns the remaining input as byte slice.

methods.name: as_str
methods.summary: Returns the remaining input as string slice.

methods.name: chars
methods.summary: Return the remaining input as a string slice.

methods.name: eat_char
methods.signature: fn eat_char(&mut self, c: char) -> bool

methods.name: eat_char2
methods.signature: fn eat_char2(&mut self, c1: char, c2: char) -> bool
methods.summary: Eats the next two characters if they are `c1` and `c2`. Does not consume any input otherwise, even if the first character matches.

methods.name: eat_char3
methods.signature: fn eat_char3(&mut self, c1: char, c2: char, c3: char) -> bool
methods.summary: Eats the next three characters if they are `c1`, `c2` and `c3` Does not consume any input otherwise, even if the first character matches.

methods.name: eat_if
methods.signature: fn eat_if(&mut self, predicate: impl FnMut(char) -> bool) -> bool
methods.summary: Eats the next character if `predicate` returns `true`.

methods.name: eat_while
methods.signature: fn eat_while(&mut self, predicate: impl FnMut(char) -> bool)
methods.summary: Eats symbols while predicate returns true or until the end of file is reached.

methods.name: first
methods.summary: Peeks the next character from the input stream without consuming it. Returns [`EOF_CHAR`] if the file is at the end of the file.

methods.name: is_eof
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the file is at the end of the file.

methods.name: offset
methods.summary: Retrieves the current offset of the cursor within the source code.

methods.name: second
methods.summary: Peeks the second character from the input stream without consuming it. Returns [`EOF_CHAR`] if the position is past the end of the file.
